开放题（官方：Student's own answers）。参考：
Hi Frank, Don't worry about last night! I'm sorry you weren't well. Are you OK now? I went to the cinema with my classmates.
The film was very funny. Yes, I want to do something together soon! Let's go to a concert next Saturday. Love, Rio
